name: JG_FSCL_DOC_TYPES_
description: This table contains Fiscal Document Types definitions to be used by fiscal document processing of Remittance Fiscal Document, Symbolic Remittance Fiscal Document and Sale Fiscal Document.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_TYPE
columns.description: Fiscal document type of the transaction. Valid values are Remittance Fiscal Document, Symbolic Remittance Fiscal Document, and Sale Fiscal Document.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code for which the fiscal document type is defined.

columns.name: REFERENCE_FSCL_DOC_TYPE
columns.description: Fiscal document type that is used as a reference fiscal document when a reference to another fiscal document is required. For example, the symbolic remittance fiscal document needs to provide the details of the remittance fiscal document as the reference fiscal document.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
